findings.IDENTITY: Master identities, coverage and worker histories are byte-identical to v1.0.2 apart from generation run IDs; 22,000 patient versions and 900 worker assignment versions round-trip exactly through native files.
findings.CLINICAL: All clinical domain controls and realism targets pass (mean stay 5.08 days, long-stay tail 4.7%). ED stays, ward-round readiness and daytime discharges follow the revision; notes remain grounded in recorded facts and timing.
findings.OPERATIONS_WORKFORCE: Bed placement, cleaning and capacity waits are graded; capacity transfers 625 (from 539). RN absence 2.5% with winter rise, covered by colleague pickups and agency staff. RN overtime stays low by scope (88 RNs per hospital).
findings.FINANCE: Initial insured denial rate 9.30% within the frozen 8-12% band, now varying by payer and setting; six consumers reconcile claims, cash, costs and Axiom series with zero unexplained differences.
findings.DATA_ENGINEERING: Seven-stage cold rebuild reproduces the candidate exactly; 3,445 native files reconstruct every row; 318 snapshots, 304 Axiom headers and 15 faults pass; the package verifies against descriptor c36a9b78 and the bundle reproduces offline.
